player_setup_description: Add resources before configuring playback and visuals.
player_add_resources_prompt: Add a model, motion, stage, and skybox option to begin.
player_settings_library_description: Browse and manage resources cached on this device.
player_settings_show_lyrics_description: Shows time-synced lyrics over the wallpaper when the current track has them.
player_settings_lyrics_style_description: Customize how lyrics appear over the wallpaper.
player_settings_lyrics_karaoke_descripti: Animated fill that follows the active lyric line.
player_settings_lyrics_shadow_descriptio: Soft shadow that keeps lyrics readable on bright scenes.
player_settings_mme_effects_description: Browser-native versions of common MME post effects.
player_settings_stage_effects_descriptio: Applies the stage's built-in material, lighting, emissive, and bloom tuning.
player_settings_reload_on_change: Changing this option reloads the current resources.
player_settings_planar_reflections_descr: Renders stage-profile and WorkingFloor mirrors. This can be expensive on the GPU.
player_settings_reload_on_reflection_cha: Changing reflection settings reloads the current resources.
player_settings_bloom_description: Soft glow around bright highlights, similar to AutoLuminous.
player_settings_depth_of_field_descripti: Camera-focused blur inspired by ikBokeh and PowerDOF.
player_settings_vignette_description: Darkens the frame edges to draw attention to the model.
player_settings_filmic_tone_mapping_desc: ACES tone mapping keeps bright areas filmic and controlled.
player_settings_reload_on_rendering_mode: Changing this option reloads the current model.
player_settings_ambient_material_color_d: Uses the model's ambient color in the final diffuse color.
player_settings_missing_toon_fallback_de: Keeps materials without a toon texture from becoming too dark.
player_settings_sphere_maps_description: Enables sphere maps used for metallic and glossy highlights.
player_settings_toon_maps_description: Enables the model's toon-ramp shading textures.
player_settings_render_quality_descripti: Presets balance visual fidelity against GPU cost. Advanced options tune each effect individually.
player_settings_rim_light_description: Faint cool back light that separates the model from the background.
player_settings_texture_filtering_descri: Sharpens angled and distant model or stage textures.
player_settings_fxaa_description: Fast post-process filter that smooths remaining jagged edges after MSAA.
player_settings_ambient_occlusion_descri: Darkens crevices between hair, clothes and body for depth.
player_settings_screen_space_reflections: Screen-space reflections on glossy surfaces. Experimental with MMD toon materials; best on reflective stages.
player_settings_physics_engine_descripti: Bullet matches how MMD itself simulates skirts and hair, and honors the model's joint springs. Havok loads faster but drops those settings. Changing the engine reloads the current resources.
player_settings_physics_step_rate_descri: Higher rates simulate hair and skirts more smoothly at a CPU cost.
player_settings_solver_bullet_only: Only available with the Bullet engine.
player_settings_solver_iterations_descri: More iterations resolve clipping between hair, clothes and skin more reliably.
player_settings_physics_strength_descrip: Stiffness of the model's joints; below 1 makes hair and skirts softer, above 1 stiffer. Changing this value reloads the current resources.
player_settings_joint_limit_description: Lower joint limits keep the model's original hair and skirt motion; higher values improve stability on broken joints. Changing SSAO, SSR, physics or this value reloads the current resources.
player_settings_fps_overlay_description: RTSS-style frame time monitor over the wallpaper. Toggle it anytime with the
player_settings_show_performance_overlay: Shows FPS, frame time, 1% lows and GPU stats over the wallpaper.
player_settings_waiting_for_frames: Waiting for the first rendered frames…
player_playlist_description: Combine any model, motion, stage, and skybox. Audio and camera follow the selected motion. The list loops continuously and is saved automatically on this device.
web_local_library_load_failed: Local library could not be loaded
web_empty_playlist_description: Open player setup below, then add at least one model, motion, and stage. Everything you add is cached only on this device.
library_description: Browse independent resource sources and manage artifacts installed on this device.
library_empty_title: Add a resource source to get started
library_empty_description: A source can be an R2 public domain, an nginx directory, or any HTTPS URL containing catalog.json.
library_no_search_results: No resources from enabled sources match this search.
library_updates_available: {count} updates available — versions are refreshed from the catalog.
library_one_update_available: 1 update available — versions are refreshed from the catalog.
library_none_installed: No resources are installed on this device.
library_source_url_description: Root URLs, subpaths, and direct catalog.json URLs are supported. The host must allow browser CORS.
library_remove_source_description: Choose whether resources already installed from this source should remain available on this device. Both options remove the source and its cached catalog.
library_delete_resource_description: This removes the resource from the player and deletes its local files when they are not shared by another installed resource. The resource source remains configured.
web_eula_description: The default resource source provides resources contributed by community third parties. Please review the agreement below before using it.
